item.title: Hokenshitsu no Sensei to Koakuma na Kaichou
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Citrus
  • 発売日: 2022-05-27
  • スコア: 6.5200000000000005/10 (42 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 保健室のセンセーと小悪魔な会長
  • 英語名: Hokenshitsu no Sensei to Koakuma na Kaichou

别名

  • Hokecho

あらすじ

“See you later, Sensei,”

“Let’s go on another wonderful date with me!”

Initially slated to leave after the first term, Kazami Sora continues his role as the school’s health counselor into the second term at Saika Girls’ Academy.

Shirobana, his traveling companion, is still working as his assistant. However, the two no longer live together at Shikisai Home, a hot spring resort.

item.title: Tasogare no Folclore
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Citrus
  • 発売日: 2019-06-28
  • スコア: 6.959999999999999/10 (52 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 黄昏のフォルクローレ
  • 英語名: Tasogare no Folclore

别名

  • Tasokuro

あらすじ

Arima, the son of a doctor, lived in the capital of a nation that had been founded a few decades ago and which had undergone remarkable development. When his father succumbed suddenly to illness, he was left without any family. Fortunately, he was taken in by the noble Otobe family to work as the attendant for their lone daughter Supika, who had a frail constitution.
